structural_change: S81-DIE7/PVRD 10-18: first hardened view of dsfd_dvland_pvrd (S81-DIE5 RTL; 2 instances in bind9 / p4l: links pv_W -> s_3S, pv_E -> s_4S, from svc entries rsv_05 / rsv_11 over one dsfd_dvrlyh_562 chain, 2 stations, E 2 / K 2 / D 4): the P.V 562-b lane LANDING (ot_s81_land W 562 D 4: ring written on the forwarded lane clock ck_f, read on the slice root ck at K) + a static fixed-latency width adapter (one register, +1 edge) into the C3 slice band port bi (1104-b RD beat: leaf w mod 5, row rb + 4 (w div 5), pairs 2). No ready, no backpressure, no credit; fault = slot-epoch check | head-flag calendar slip (assertion only). Two CTS roots (ck receiver root, ck_f lane capture), related same frequency, fixed-latency ring. Faces from the p4l plan: lane i + ck_f on S (from rsv_05 / rsv_11 below), o abutted N to the slice S-face band port bi with the slice root ck and regional reset rs, straps / fault on W.
